## What I do {.section-label}
:::

I'm a Data Science Lecturer in the
[Statistics Department](https://www.stat.ubc.ca/)
at the University of British Columbia,
teaching in UBC Statistics and the
[Master of Data Science](https://masterdatascience.ubc.ca/) Vancouver program.

## What I've done {.section-label}
:::

- Data Science Educator & Developer Advocate at [Posit, PBC](https://posit.co/) (FKA RStudio)
- Author of *Pandas for Everyone* (2nd ed.)
- Instructor with [The Carpentries](https://carpentries.org/) since 2014

### Education

- **Virginia Tech** — PhD, Genetics, Bioinformatics, and Computational Biology (2022).
  Data science education in the biomedical sciences.
- **Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health** — MPH, Epidemiology (2014).
  Spread of ideas in social networks.
- **Macaulay Honors College, CUNY Hunter College** — BA, Psychology & Behavioral Neuroscience (2012).
  Learning and memory.
